title: Committing a workflow file through the API returns 403 'Resource not accessible by personal access token'
symptoms: 403 Resource not accessible by personal access token
Other files commit fine with the same token
cause: Writing files under .github/workflows requires the workflow scope on the token.
fix: Use a token with the workflow scope, or commit the workflow by hand.
apply: Classic PAT: tick workflow. Fine-grained PAT: Repository permissions > Workflows: Read and write
